name: printing
description: Label pool management and QR/barcode PNG generation. Use the Inventari Print Agent for local printer integration.

permission_action_exceptions.printing:agent: A part a machine plays rather than an action on the print queue: the print agent registers its printer, claims jobs, fetches their labels and reports how they went. It is one permission so that a key can be bound to exactly that work, which is what the printing API key scope is.
